counterweight_cradle.tray_index_access: Remove and reinstall the M2 index screw and nut at the other fixed shelf hole before releasing the tray. Pivot remains retained.

admission.rail_clearance_and_fits: Use existing finished manual slide fits; measure and lock at index. Existing nominal printed clearance is not certified repeatability.
requires: Measured index seating and cup center
Proof with surrogate mass before cord service
No rail binding through release and switch positions
Full machine swept clearance and cord custody check

procedure: Close both service nips and support main carrier at Z160 before cord switching. These nips are a separate integration dependency.
From stowed tray, place slide 3 mm below the current cup center. Support slide manually, remove vertical index screw only after taking load, and loosen side lock.
Unlock M2 tray index, swivel tray to 0 degrees while below cup, reinstall M2 screw/nut. The M3 pivot always stays retained.
Raise slide until tray supports the cup at its actual center, engage vertical index screw at the selected HIGH or LOW hole, tighten its retaining nut and side lock before touching cord attachment.

For a mode change keep one hand on the slide, remove vertical index screw, loosen side lock and move cup continuously at at most 2 mm/s to the other index. Retain cup on tray, do not lift it by its cord.
At target, insert index screw/nut and lock slide, finish cord attachment, and establish cord support before lowering cradle 3 mm.
After load transfers to cord, lower cradle 3 mm, rotate tray to 90 degrees, reinstall tray index screw/nut, and leave vertical side lock tightened. The tray then clears the full counterweight travel.

must_measure: Wet/dry friction and damage after hold

service_nips.closed_state: C-shims sit on top of upper jaw, beneath both M2 screw heads. Upper jaw bears on two 1.5 mm brass shoulders, placing the two 0.5 mm pad faces 0.5 mm apart.
service_nips.open_state: Move each 1.0 mm C-shim beneath upper jaw onto its shoulder. Upper jaw rises exactly the shim thickness; screws return to the same underhead plane and remain fully engaged.
opening_procedure: Establish receiving nip grip before loosening donor nip. Keep one nip closed throughout service.
Support upper plate. Loosen each M2 actuator no more than 1.2 mm (three turns at 0.4 mm pitch); nuts and upper plate remain retained.
Slide each open C-shim out from under its screw head, raise the upper plate 1.0 mm and slide the shim onto its shoulder beneath the upper plate. Keep shims outside Y405.7…406.3 yarn corridor.
Tighten both M2 screws against the hard open stack. Verify 1.47…1.53 mm metal-face gap before source payout.
Reverse the shim transfer to close; do not force yarn against a closed nip during payout. Prove grip before opening the other nip.
custody_sequence: RUN: IN closed, OUT open; working material follows actual feeder and guide.
HOLD: close OUT while IN remains closed; record gripped material coordinate and verify grip.
REFILL: keep OUT closed, support carrier and open IN; append measured upstream material only at source, preserving existing material coordinates.
RELOCK: close and prove IN at carrier Z160; both nips are closed for mode/cord service.
RESUME: establish the selected feeder load and settle it, then open OUT; IN remains closed.
service_nips.forbidden: Both nips open simultaneously; changing fixed material IDs without a physical regrip; treating a geometric face gap as proof of friction force.
service_nips.source_supply: Finite manually measured supply packet upstream of IN; no automatic spool or infinite material source is implied.
service_nips.material_boundary_note: Installed centers are closed gap midpoints. Opening raises upper pad only, moving midpoint by 0.5 mm. Use actual unilateral pad contacts and measured compression for closing; do not pin open yarn to the closed midpoint.
